units.source_text: 金阁的美是无与伦比的。

en.t: The beauty of the Golden Pavilion was beyond compare.

units.source_text: 我知道我的不堪的劳顿是从哪里来的。

en.t: I knew where my unbearable exhaustion came from.

units.source_text: 美在最后的机会再次发挥它的威力，企图用过去曾经无数次袭击过我的无力感来束缚我。

en.t: Beauty, at this final opportunity, once again exerted its power, trying to bind me with the sense of helplessness that had attacked me countless times in the past.
My arms and legs lost their strength.

units.source_text: 直至刚才，只差一步就行动的我，再度从这里大大地后退了。

en.t: Until just a moment ago I had been only one step away from acting, but now I drew far back from that point once again.
